description: Submit a signed Proofable check using the same wallet, checks, data, and chain used to prepare it, plus the returned signing timestamp and signature. Creates a proof only when verification succeeds.

chain.description: Network identifier. Omit when Proofable infers it from the address format.

data.description: Inputs required by the selected verifier, named exactly as proofable_verifiers_catalog lists them. ownership-basic saves text in data.content (not summary or contentText) and, when signed in, fills owner from the current account.

options.description: Optional proof settings. Proofs stay private and offchain unless privacyLevel is "public" or publishToHub is true; a job run can set neither. Pass options.meta.title / options.meta.tags / options.meta.source to label a proof at creation.

meta.description: Auxiliary metadata stored with the proof. Only recognized keys persist.

source.description: Ref attribution source label (stored as meta.source).

tags.description: Portable classification tags. Work items use work-item, status:todo (or backlog|in-progress|review|done|canceled), workspace:<active-namespace>, and optional priority:urgent|high|medium|low. A workspace tag indexes an item but does not share it.

title.description: Proof title shown in listings and search.

signature.description: Signature over the exact signerString returned by proofable_verify_prepare.

walletAddress.description: Wallet or DID used to prepare the signing string.

name: proofable_verify_submit
title: Submit signed verification
